FROZEN SOURCE FAILURE — Lin arXiv2510.07162v1
Status: exact mathematical counterexample under the stated symmetric CL sampler interpretation; the published predicate is the target.

B. COUNTEREXAMPLE TO THE PUBLISHED DETYPING COMPLETENESS CLAIM
Interpretation boundary: use the intended symmetric Bob-prefix completion of Definition5.8, consistent with its swapped first/second outputs, its CL dependence on the Bob local prior output, and its stated Equation27 parser. The source leaves these Bob activation conditions implicit and contains a dimension-equality typo; the fixture uses the explicitly parsed six seed components. No conclusion is drawn for an arbitrarily altered/asymmetric completion of those incomplete formulas.

Use p=1, m=1, k=1, type set T={0,1}, and the complete two-vertex type graph INCLUDING both self loops. Both original one-level CL maps L_0,L_1:F_2→F_2 are identically zero. Original supported questions are (v,0), v∈{0,1}. Use common answer alphabet A={0,1}, with predicate
  V((v,0),(u,0),a,b)=1[a xor b = v xor u].
Thus diagonal questions require equal answers, all equal answer pairs are accepted there, and different type labels require opposite answers. The strategy a=v, b=u wins perfectly. Its measurements are scalar 0/I, so it is classical, globally synchronous and oracularizable under Lin's stricter within-algebra definition. All supplied premises of Lemma5.11 are met.

Both neighbour vectors are N=(1,1). The detyping seed prefix is
  (s0,s1,s2,s3,s4,s5),
where s0,s2 are single bits and s1,s3,s4,s5 are independent two-bit vectors. There are 2^10 equally likely effective prefixes. The extra body bit is unused by L_v=0, so summing it out preserves the following exact masses.

For Alice, first output is (s0,s1,0,0). If s1=N the second output is (s4,(s5)_{s0}); otherwise it is (0,0). Bob uses (s2,s3,0,0), and if s3=N outputs (s5,(s4)_{s2}); otherwise zero. Here (u)_v keeps only coordinate v. The old body output is always0.

Define three actual full question strings, writing the zero blocks with their correct two-bit sizes:
  z  = (0,00,0,00,00,00,0),
  x0 = (0,11,0,00,11,10,0),
  y1 = (1,11,0,00,11,01,0).
These are common formal question strings, even though only x0 is needed as an Alice input and y1 as a Bob input below.

The following four support pairs occur with their exact masses and predicates:
  Alice x0, Bob z : mass 1/512, equality;

INDEPENDENT DETYPING AUDIT — 2026-10-08

VERDICT
An explicit finite two-type, binary-answer game refutes the perfect-completeness
clause of Junqiao Lin, arXiv:2510.07162v1, Lemma 5.11, under Definition 5.8's
intended symmetric processed-prefix reading and Definition 5.10's printed
equality fallback. The original game has a perfect scalar, globally synchronous,
oracularizable strategy in both tensor and commuting models. The detyped game
has commuting value strictly below one, uniformly in Hilbert-space dimension.
The independent frozen proof gives loss >=1/4096. After the freeze, cross-audit
confirmed the originating worker's sharper CHSH bound (2-sqrt(2))/1024.

The local predicate repair and the sampler's spectral-gap certificate pass the
cross-audit with the explicit premises below. The repaired ordinary values are
exactly affine, not merely bounded in one direction. This is a failure and repair
of one source interface, not a disproof or validation of the full MIPco=coRE
theorem, and not a refutation or independent validation of L02 repetition.

INDEPENDENCE AND SOURCE PROVENANCE
Read work/BRIEF.txt and the pinned 00_START_HERE navigation instructions.
Read only original source files from the originating lane before freezing.
FROZEN_DERIVATION.txt was saved and sent to root before reading any peer argument.
Root subsequently authorized comparison; read repetition_application/REPORT.txt.
No descendants, external messages, publishing, purchases or external jobs.
